title: P1d smoke: static external-read plan
kind: P1d single-variable external-read selection; discovery only
hypothesis: P1c achieved real tool use but the model chose local ranges. Selecting external caller/callee/enclosing spans with the static call context, and reading them before the hypothesis stage, should expose the DASH format_id/data-source relation that the model missed. If the candidate still does not match, external read selection is not the bottleneck.
selection_reason: youtube-dl-2 has a static caller (_extract_mpd_formats), callees and an enclosing definition, and the reference issue is a DASH format_id uniqueness/merge relation rather than a single local line. Both sides, one r0 window per side.
metrics: external spans selected and actually read
adoption: A strict reference candidate hit, or a clearly closer root-cause candidate with the correct DASH format_id/merge trigger, with no fixed-side alarm; otherwise reject. One-case/two-window smoke is exploratory.
scope: Discovery only; no evidence engine, official tests/labels/opposite version in the Agent input. One repetition; all requests, failures and no-span windows retained.
